name: local-browser-automation-bridge
description: Local prototype that bridges two websites in Chrome via a backend, dashboard, SQLite queue, and a single Manifest V3 extension.

scripts.dev:dedicated: cross-env PORT=14000 LBAB_BACKEND_PORT=14000 LBAB_DASHBOARD_PORT=14173 LBAB_EXTENSION_PORT=14174 VITE_BACKEND_WS_URL=ws://localhost:14000/ws pnpm -r --parallel --filter "./apps/*" run dev
scripts.dev:dedicated:dashboard: cross-env LBAB_BACKEND_PORT=14000 LBAB_DASHBOARD_PORT=14173 pnpm --filter @lbab/dashboard run dev
